fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM116,395. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0006054/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass SPM minimum THREE (3) credits, including Bahasa Melayu, Mathematics, and a Science subject (e.g., Biology, Physics, Chemistry), plus pass in English and two other subjects; OR Possess Assistant Nurse Certificate/ Community Nurse Certificate, Registered with the MNB, and minimum THREE (3) years clinical experience. Vocational Certificate (SVM): Minimum C for Bahasa Melayu, Mathematics, Science, English, and two other subjects (academic or vocational); Pass in Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia (STAM) with Maqbul level in four (4) subjects, including Arabic and Usuluddin or Syariah. International students: IELTS with an Overall Band Score of minimum 5.5, or TOEFL score: PBT 515, CBT 215, IBT 80; or equivalent English proficiency tests.
